states.changed: First state: the International AI Safety Report 2026 set whole, 2,323 sentences in page columns, its 41 measured claims on legs down to the 58 sources they cite; a second run passes along the ground and fills 27 of the slots where someone outside the maker could run a test again, lighting 19 claims, while 22 claims go dark, every pass mark stays in a solid red footing, and step 3's nine leave nine empty slots.

Second state, corrected on the Field's blind second reading: a second run's copy appears under 28 tests but is solid under only 12, its light climbs each leg only as far as the source holds what the report says and stops short on 20 legs, so 10 claims light instead of 19; below, the tests stand in rows by what they test for, filled by the same run (what a model can do 5 of 28, what it does 6 of 16, each of those six marked trained, told or asked, the rest 1 of 5), and step 3's nine deeds, done untold, 0 of 9.

The check, written into the work: a last frame gathers the 41 measured claims (10 a second run could reach, one of them only once; 10 where its light would stop short; 14 on tests only their runner holds, 3 on sources that do not say, 4 on no test) beside the 160 that measure nothing, and sets every test in a row by what it is for and a column by who can reach it, so the maker's red and all four of its lines stand together on the closed side; a second run is drawn in its mood, hatched where it could be made and struck where its hosted model is gone; conduct gets a dashed 'no line', its six reached tests bracketed trained, told, asked, three closed ones bracketed untold, and a dashed 'no test' above step 3's nine, now deeds, 0 of 9 records read outside; a dated note says what was checked, what held and what was corrected.
